title: ynh migrate --format json
description: Output of `ynh migrate --format json`. What a schema migration of the ynh home did, or would do under --dry-run. Most commands migrate automatically on first use, so this reports work that usually happens invisibly. Envelope retrofit deferred, matching the other Phase 3 commands.

MigratedEntry.description: One id that moved. Recorded old and new so a migration can be explained after the fact, not merely counted.

old_id.description: The legacy identifier — a bare name for pointer files, a bare or namespaced name for tree installs.

kind.description: Which legacy layout this entry came from.

QuarantinedEntry.description: A path migration could not handle. It is moved aside rather than deleted or left in place — see `ynh quarantine`, which lists and recovers these.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was written. The rest of the payload then describes what would have happened.

schema_version.description: The schema version the home is at after this run.

entries.description: Null when nothing needed migrating — distinct from an empty array only by JSON encoding, so treat both as "none".

quarantined.description: Null when nothing was quarantined. A non-empty list means the migration completed but left entries behind that need a human.
